      "section": "mod-tome/data/talents/techniques/unarmed-discipline.lua",
      "source": "When gaining a combo point, you have a %d%% chance to gain an extra combo point. Additionally, every time you earn a combo point, you will regain %0.2f stamina, or %0.2f stamina if you would exceed 5 combo points.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "每当获得连击点时，你有 %d%% 几率额外获得 1 点。此外，每次获得连击点时，你会恢复 %0.2f 体力；若连击点将超过 5 点，则改为恢复 %0.2f 体力。触发额外连击点时，恢复量翻倍。"

      "notes": "Lite review batch 0544 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/timed_effects/magical.lua",
      "source": "The target is out of phase with reality, increasing defense by %d, resist all by %d%%, and reducing the duration of detrimental timed effects by %d%%.\nThese effects cap at 40%%.",

      "special": null,
      "target": "目标脱离现实相位，闪避提高 %d 点，全体伤害抗性提高 %d%%， 负面状态的持续时间缩短 %d%%。\n闪避加成上限为 40 点，另两项加成上限均为 40%%。"
    },

      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "90a38ad068834a458a1f22057e9436573a12185e0dbea6fc683463d266ad0117",

      "source": "When a ghoul is hit or dies, it explodes, doing %0.2f frostdusk damage.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "食尸鬼受到伤害或死亡时会爆炸，造成 %0.2f 霜暮伤害（每回合至多引爆一只）。"
    },

      "section": "mod-tome/data/timed_effects/other.lua",

Each turn you blink to a nearby foe within range %d, hitting it for %d%% darkness weapon damage. While this goes on you cannot be stopped unless you are killed, and you cannot control your character.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "你融入暗影并被其支配。笼罩在阴影中时，你免疫负面状态，并减少 %d%% 所受伤害；每回合你会闪现到 %d 格内的一个敌人身边，对其造成 %d%% 暗影武器伤害。此效果持续期间你无法控制角色，除非死亡，否则无法被打断。"
    },

      "section": "tome-ashes-urhrok/data/talents/corruptions/fearfire.lua",
      "source": "Removes all detrimental effects but causes you to burn for %d%% of your max health per effect, over 7 turns.\n\t\tThis ignores all resists, defenses, and affinities.\n\t\tThis does not take a turn.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "移除所有负面状态，但每移除一个状态，会在 7 回合内灼烧自身，受到合计 %d%% 最大生命值的伤害。\n\t\t伤害无视一切抗性、防御效果和伤害亲和。\n\t\t此技能瞬发。"

      "section": "tome-ashes-urhrok/data/talents/corruptions/heart-of-fire.lua",
      "source": "Whenever you kill a burning enemy, you will instantly deal a melee attack against a random adjacant enemy at %d%% power. \n\t\tAdditionally, Incinerating Blows will always trigger on this attack (or your next attack), dealing %d%% of its normal damage to all enemies hit and stunning, ignoring the cooldown.\n\t\tThis can only trigger once every 5 turns.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "每次你击杀一个燃烧的敌对生物时，会立刻对一个随机相邻敌对生物进行一次攻击，造成 %d%% 武器伤害。\n\t\t另外，这次攻击（或你的下一次攻击）必定触发焚尽强击，对所有击中的敌对生物造成 %d%% 正常伤害并使其震慑，无视冷却时间。\n\t\t此效果每 5 回合只能触发一次。"
    },
